description:
Dragons Dogma 2 Dark Arisen - Is There an Elden Ring / Dark Souls Connection?
In this Fextralife video I’m going to be talking about what I love about the world of Dragon’s Dogma and Dragon’s Dogma 2, and the narrative devices those games use. We’ll take a look at what I find interesting about the cyclical nature of the story and how the idea of “breaking the wheel” has become a common trope in a lot of modern fantasy games. I’ll then talk a little about why I’m excited for the upcoming expansion, Dark Arisen, and what the lore of the previous games can teach us about where the expansion’s story might be headed.
